description: This file defines the class 'EditViewMerge', which handles merging and manipulating view metadata for the SugarCRM/ SuiteCRM platform, particularly focusing on the edit view layout of modules. It includes methods for loading, merging, and saving view definitions, as well as internal utilities for handling panels, fields, and metadata in the CRM interface.

classes.name: EditViewMerge
classes.description: A class responsible for merging and editing view metadata definitions for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM views, especially edit views. It contains properties and methods to load, merge, and save view configuration data, handle metadata panels and fields, and log operations.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets internal data arrays to prepare for a new merge operation.

methods.name: setBestMatch
methods.description: Enables or disables the best match algorithm for panel field placement.

methods.name: setDefaultPanel
methods.description: Sets the default panel name for layout in case panels are not explicitly specified.

methods.name: setLogFilePointer
methods.description: Sets an existing file pointer for logging.

methods.name: setLogFile
methods.description: Opens a file for logging debug or merge operations.

methods.name: areMatchingValues
methods.description: Recursively compares two values (or arrays) to determine if they match.

methods.name: arrayMerge
methods.description: Recursively merges two arrays, with values from the second array overriding those in the first when keys match.

methods.name: mergeField
methods.description: Merges metadata for an individual field considering original, new, and custom data.

methods.name: mergeFields
methods.description: Merges all fields from custom, original, and new data into a unified set for layout processing.

methods.name: buildPanels
methods.description: Builds the layout panels for the merged view, arranging fields according to placement and matching options.

methods.name: mergeTemplateMeta
methods.description: Merges templateMeta section of view defs, giving precedence to custom definitions.

methods.name: setPanels
methods.description: Assigns the constructed panels back into the new view data structure.

methods.name: mergeMetaData
methods.description: Coordinates merging of fields, panels, and templateMeta across original, new, and custom metadata.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Extracts field information and their layout positions from panel definitions.

methods.name: getPanelIds
methods.description: Returns array of panel IDs from a panels structure.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads original, new, and custom view metadata from specified files.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the merged view definition data to a specified file.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the current merged view metadata.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Main entry point to perform merging of view metadata files from original, new, and custom sources, optionally saving the result.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages either to an internal file pointer or to the global logger.
